{{Quote|We'll be disassembled, cannibalized for scrap, sent to the sandmines of Neelgaimon or the orbital factories around Ryloon!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="CJ" />}}
'''Ryloon''' was an astronomical object<ref name="CJ" /> located in the [[Ryloon system/Legends|eponymous star system]], a part of the [[Velcar sector/Legends|Velcar sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], captured [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] were sent to work in several Imperial-controlled<ref name="CE" /> [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] factories situated around Ryloon.<ref name="CJ" />

Ryloon fell within the borders of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], and remained part of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] following its [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|peace agreement]] with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ryloon was first mentioned<ref name="CJ" /> in the [[1995]] novel [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']], written by [[Barbara Hambly]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Ryloon system/Legends|Ryloon star system]] and the object itself in grid square J-5.<ref name="EA" />
